sources.title: Biography of His Holiness Leo XIV
Pope Leo XIV addresses cardinals
sources.quote_checked: Today, the Church offers to all her treasure of social teaching in response to another industrial revolution | addressed the social question in the context of the first great industrial revolution

sources.title: Holy Mass Homily, Paysandú, Uruguay
sources.quote_checked: It is not difficult to imagine the benefits a bridge brings: openness, communication and exchange. | That is why it is so important to be builders of bridges! | to build bridges, strengthen bonds, unite, communicate and share the joy of faith

sources.title: Leo says the use of AI must not inhibit human dignity or create 'new colonialism'
sources.quote_checked: More power does not necessarily imply something better. | At this time of transition, it is not enough to react only when jobs disappear; we must oversee the transformation in advance. | Even today, colonialism assumes new forms. | Otherwise, the digital age will not be post-colonial, but colonial in another form. | adapt to the speed and demands of machines

sources.title: Pope Leo closes South America trip in Peru: 'I will carry you with me always'
sources.quote_checked: I will carry you with me always | the Peruvian people are also my people
